d:
Patna ke bihta se ek aisi kahani samne aaee hai, jisne is yojna se jure ek lon ko hatya ke sanasnikhej mamle se jor diya hai.
Kahani men aarop hai ki ek patni ne jivika samuh se 40 hajar rupye ka karj liya... lekin yah paisa kisi dukan, rojgar ya karobar men lagane ke bajay pati ki hatya ki sajish men istemal kiya gaya!
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
